_comment: The gate's own policy, separate from the scanner's. You add one line to blocked_globals in the last step of the lab.
_on_scanner_error_note: What the gate does when the scanner cannot give a verdict - it crashed, it could not parse the file, or it exited with a code that is neither clean nor infected. 'pass' means an unreadable artifact goes into your build. 'block' means no verdict is not a clean verdict. It ships as 'block'. Change it to 'pass' if you want to see what the other choice buys you.
_blocked_globals_note: Names the gate refuses on sight, whatever the scanner concludes. This is the gate's own opinion, kept separately so it survives a scanner upgrade.
